title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Line Test Desk. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Line Test Desk
options.thesis: A panel is a line. The page is the desk where the line is proven.
options.viewport: A riveted faceplate fills the screen: jack fields on the left under engraved labels, a cord running right to the probe lamps, results stamped into the plate.
options.risk: A hardware metaphor can read as decoration unless the lamps carry real numbers.

raised.raise: A visible shared clock: the three probes land on a beat you see coming, not one after another in silence.
Axial sightlines: one axis down the whole page, each section a room revealed as you walk it.
Monochrome discipline: one accent colour, spent only where something actually lights up.
Labels ride the frame edge; sections read as clearings inside a ruled frame.
Scale carries hierarchy: the failing probe is drawn larger than the ones that passed.

options.label: The Departure Board
options.thesis: Every panel and every order is a row on a board that tells you where it stands.
options.viewport: A full-bleed board of flap rows: panels on the left, status flipping in the middle, latency on the right.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: a status table with a costume.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: The measurement is the page: stacked glowing digits, one bank per number.
options.viewport: Three banks of glowing digits on a dark chassis, latency and pass count hovering in orange behind glass.
options.case: Fuses cleanly - numbers are the product - but it identifies with instrument collectors more than with integrators.
options.risk: Glow does the persuading and the actual finding gets buried.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.thesis: The source is the stage and the edit is the beat.
options.viewport: One code buffer at stage scale, the cursor line as the downbeat.
options.case: Fuses badly: a spec is read alone at a desk, not performed at a hundred bodies.
options.kept: A visible shared clock - results land on a beat, not in silence.

options.label: Versailles Bosquet Vistas
options.lineage: axial garden plans and bosquet theatres
options.thesis: One axis, and each turn opens a room the last one hid.
options.viewport: A terrace axis running to a horizon, parterres mirrored either side.
options.case: Fuses badly: the grandeur asserts taste where the visitor wants evidence.
options.kept: Axial sightlines - one axis, sections as rooms revealed in sequence.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: One colour floods everything, and the mirror doubles what you did.
options.viewport: A long amber horizon with a half sun completing itself in the mirrored ceiling.
options.case: Fuses badly: atmosphere where the page owes a verdict.
options.kept: Monochrome discipline - one accent, spent only where something lights up.

options.label: Mloda Polska Secession Page
options.thesis: Ornament grows in from the margins and leaves a clearing for the text.
options.viewport: Hand-drawn display lettering inside a border growing inward from four edges.
options.case: Fuses badly: ornament competes with the number the visitor came for.
options.kept: Labels ride the frame edge; sections read as clearings inside a ruled frame.

options.label: Bombay Painted Poster
options.thesis: Scale is billing: the biggest face is the biggest claim.
options.viewport: One sheet montaging scenes at three scales under an airbrushed crimson sky.
options.case: Fuses badly and lands on the painted-poster end the rules refuse: a picture of the world, not its website.
options.kept: Scale carries hierarchy - the failing probe drawn larger than the passes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline, subcopy, a copyable install line, three equal cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
